## v0.5.14 · Desktop Loading, OpenViking User Keys and Agent Teams Review

- [#277](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/277) fixes Desktop profile bundle loading on older Cosmokit hosts, preserving live settings on newer hosts and existing component switches and namespaces.
- [#276](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/276) adds scoped OpenViking discovery with an explicitly configured user-key owner. It validates the data API without Admin access and retains the prior configuration when a replacement is rejected.
- [#278](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/278) supports guarded idle review with the verified DSH/Agent Teams 0.1.7-rc.1 combination and preserves complete live-user decisions in bounded checkpoints. Reviewer Team delegation stays denied; parent Team tools remain usable.

### Packages and upgrade

**dsh-mnemon 0.5.14**, **dsh-mnemon-provider-openviking 0.5.6**, and **dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces 0.5.9** form the updated composition. The other fourteen companion packages retain their versions. Mnemon CLI remains independently maintained; real CLI checks use 0.2.9.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.14
```

Back up the DSH profile and relevant Mnemon data before upgrading, then restart DSH and reload the browser. Use `headless` for that Profile. Client compatibility still starts at DSH 0.1.5-rc.1; complete profiles need Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

**Agent Teams defaults to `idleReview.agentTeams: pause`.** Enable `scoped` explicitly with the verified DSH/Teams 0.1.7-rc.1 combination. Older DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 plus Teams 0.1.5-alpha.2 can still reject the reviewer with `TEAM_NOT_MEMBER`; no automatic enablement or policy bypass is added. Storage formats are unchanged. Downgrades require reconciling the optional new settings with the backed-up profile.

### 中文说明

本版修复旧版 Cosmokit 宿主上的 Desktop Profile bundle 加载；新增 OpenViking User Key 所属用户配置，通过限定范围的数据 API 完成无需 Admin 权限的发现，并保留失败替换前的配置；支持已验证 DSH/Agent Teams 0.1.7-rc.1 组合中的受限空闲审查，完整保留有界检查点内的真实用户决定，禁止审查器进行 Team 委派，同时保留父级 Team 工具。

主包升级至 **0.5.14**，OpenViking Provider 升级至 **0.5.6**，Memory Spaces Source 升级至 **0.5.9**，其余十四个插件版本不变。升级前备份 Profile 与相关数据，升级后重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。**Agent Teams 默认仍为 `pause`**，确认使用已验证的 0.1.7-rc.1 组合后手动选择 `scoped`。旧版 0.1.5-rc.2/Teams alpha.2 仍可能出现 `TEAM_NOT_MEMBER`。存储格式不变，降级时结合备份核对新增可选设置。

### Evidence

[Desktop loading and cold restart](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.14/docs/pr-assets/issue-274-profile-generation/README.md), [OpenViking discovery](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.14/docs/pr-assets/issue-271-user-key/README.md), and [guarded Team review](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.14/docs/pr-assets/issue-275-agent-teams/README.md) retain before/after evidence and real WebUI screenshots. Provider/model replies use explicit loopback fixtures; browser, DSH tools, storage and CLI operations are real. These checks do not certify live cloud-account behavior or model quality. 证据保留原始故障、修复结果及真实 WebUI 截图；Provider/模型回复使用本地夹具，不代表真实云账户或在线模型质量验收。

The release workflow verifies versioned artifacts, all independent plugins, the full pinned Registry composition and an actual v0.4.7 upgrade before creating this Release. 发布工作流先验证版本化制品、独立插件、完整 Registry 组合和 v0.4.7 真实升级，再创建此 Release。
